sentences.text:
Author: N. Tukaramji
Bench: N. Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N. Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.3448 Of 2025
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
seeking quashment of charge sheet against petitioner/accused No.1 in C.C.No.1653 of 2024, pending on the file of the learned III Additional Junior Civil Judge-cum-III Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, at Warangal (for short, "the trial Court").
2.

entities.text: III Additional Junior Civil Judge-cum-III Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, at Warangal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Mr.Grace Sheeba Rani, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1.
3.

The petitioner is accused No.1 in C.C.No.1653 of 2024 facing accusations under Sections 420, 502 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that though the petitioner is ready to defend himself in the trial, the insistence by the trial Court for his personal appearance on every adjournment is causing severe hardship in pursuing his occupation, as such, prayed for dispensing his presence in the proceedings would remedy his hardship, however undertakes for personal appearance before the trial Court as and when directed.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor reported no specific objection.
6. I have considered the submissions of learned counsel and perused the materials on record.

7. Having considered the pleaded adversity, the personal presence of the petitioner is dispensed with in the proceedings before the trial Court in C.C.No.1653 of 2024 subject to the petitioner's appearance through his counsel on all the dates of adjournment and his personal appearance as and when directed by the trial Court.
It is made clear that any deviation would render this order ineffective.
8. With the above direction, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
